name: Sound effect synthesizer
description: Python synthesizer for whoosh, pop, ding, riser, impact, typing and record scratch, at any length and pitch. Run: python sfx_synth.py <kind> --out file.wav [--seconds S] [--pitch P] [--seed N], or "all --out-dir DIR".
whenToUse: When a ready-made sound effect is the wrong length or pitch, or a variation is needed. Place the WAV it writes on the Sound effects track.

kind.description: whoosh | pop | ding | riser | impact | typing | record_scratch

seconds.description: Length in seconds (default depends on the kind)
